name: Jens Mikkelsen
bio:
Jens Mikkelsen's path to motorsport was unconventional, beginning not on the track, but in the control room of a wind turbine manufacturer. His meticulous approach to data analysis and problem-solving caught the eye of a small Formula Ford team looking for someone to optimize their car setups. After years of honing his skills in junior formulas, Jens transitioned to a management role, bringing a data-driven, innovation focused approach to team strategy and car development. 

As sporting director for Opala Legends, Jens is known for his ability to spot and nurture young talent, and for his willingness to experiment with unconventional race strategies. He believes that success lies in a combination of technical prowess, clever management, and the courage to think outside the box. His lone wolf nature however, makes it sometimes hard for him to fully integrate into the team's social aspects.

physical.description: Jens has a lean build and an intense, focused gaze.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with data and observations.
Has a habit of tapping his pen against his teeth when deep in thought.
Insists on having a specific type of licorice available in the team garage.
